text:
alex chen: Hi team — I need to add an adult dependent (my partner) to my medical & vision midyear. They have a documented disability and live with me part-time. What paperwork is required and what's the effective date? Do we need SSA disability decision or will a clinician letter suffice? Also worried about ID cards and retro claims.

maria lopez: @alex chen thanks — good q. For adult dependents with disability we require proof of dependency + proof of disability. Typically: 1) proof of relationship/residency (lease, joint bank stmt) 2) a signed "Disabled Dependent" attestation form 3) clinician letter describing condition + start date or SSA decision. If you have SSA docs that helps but not mandatory.

jamal thomas: Adding: you'll need the completed dependent verification packet. We accept physician letter, SSDI award letter, or long-term care plan docs. We also need one proof of residence in the same household within last 90 days.

people-ops-bot: benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/dep-verification — upload docs within 60 days of QLE. :link:

alex chen: Is this a QLE? I had a change in household status (partner moved in) — how long after move-in can I add them? Can coverage be backdated to move-in date?

maria lopez: If partner moved in and that qualifies as a qualifying life event (change in household), you have 60 days to enroll. Effective date = carrier rules: usually the date of the event (move-in) if docs are submitted within 30 days; otherwise effective date is date of approval. We can request retro effective date up to 30 days with manager sign-off if there's a documented reason.

jamal thomas: Premium proration: HR runs an adjustment next payroll once docs accepted. ID cards: carriers issue new member IDs within 7–14 business days; for urgent appointments call insurer and request temporary ID. Retro claims: insurer determines eligibility — sometimes they will process claims back to move-in date if coverage is approved retroactively; payroll won't reimburse paid medical bills.

alex chen: Ok great. I'll gather: driver's license + lease + clinician letter. Who should I send to? Any special form name?

maria lopez: Upload to portal link above and cc benefits-team@redwood.com if you want a tracker. Form name: "Disabled Dependent Verification.pdf" (fillable). If you need help scanning, ping me and I can book a quick time to walk through.

alex chen: Thanks! Uploading tonight. Appreciate the quick help :pray:

maria lopez: :thumbsup: once received we'll confirm receipt and estimated process time.
